string.text: Meet with Dusk
Dusk should be in his office.
Meet Dusk
I should go talk to Dusk.
Hey, I got a mission for you. Come to my office.
Know any leaders that might be willing to help out?
Yes, theres a few, heres one for you.
Hey, I'm here for that mission

Good. We need someone to make sense of this whole damn situation. After that dimwit of a scientist did that test on that SCP; we haven't known where we are even after a week. So I need you to gather some intel and find out where the bloody hell we are. I already sent out a few scouts to gather some intel but they didn't learn much but it's a start.
Great. where would I even start to piece this all together when the scouts couldn't?

I'll tell you what they told me. First, the locals here call themselves "stalkers"; no idea if it means anything but there are sub-factions to these "stalkers" so be careful who you make contact with, not all of them are friendly. Secondly, they call this place "The Zone". It appears that this place, "The Zone", is post-apocolyptic; some kind of nuclear blast up north from a power plant the locals call "sarcophagus". These locals sure do have a unqiue naming scheme. lastly, there's some legend talking about somebody named strelok going about around campfires. These "Stalkers" say he's got knowledge about "the zone" that nobody else knows about. So, I want you to find this strelok and extract as much information you can from him.
So, find this Strelok and get info out of him. sounds easy enough but why me?
I change my mind.

Sounds easy but you know it won't be that easy, nothing is in our line of work. I have no idea where he is but it would seem that an old friend of streloks has been spotted in the swamps. The swamps are south-west from here but be careful, it's a tortuous place. As for why you? you were the one who got used to the chaotic workplace that was the facility quickly and I trust you. I'm sure you'll be able to adapt on the fly and do me proud.
Well, it's a start. I'll take the mission.

Very good. I'll add the coords I was given to your PDA. It's the last known location of streloks friend, goes by docter apparently. Be sure to talk to smith if you need any equipment touched up. Good luck.
Mission accomplished.
You made it, huh? I knew you're a tough cookie. Okay, tell me what you've got.

Aside from nightmare material for several years? I accompanied Strelok and his men on their quest into the Sarcophagus. In the meantime, I discovered quite a lot about the Zone. Found some top secret documents in clandestine labs. Strelok took them, but he told me a lot. And gave me this pendrive. It contains a few dozen encrypted gigabytes of info about the Zone's dirty little secrets.
That's definitely something I can work with. Good job. Our client'll know what to do with this.
Uhm, can we trust our client with all that info?

Trust? What are you talking about? Don't worry, we aren't selling this to any dictator or anything. We'd all like to earn some money but without blowing up the planet in the process, right? Speaking of money, you deserve a reward. If you get any nightmares, just use the money as a pillow. It should help.
What would someone like you want with strelok?
I just want information, nothing more.
What do we have here? You've come with Rogue, eh? That guy doesn't make friends easily. especially with secretive factions. What, did you threaten his family? Just joking. He doesn't have one.
Yes. I wasn't expecting Rogue to recruit anyone.
I can scarcely believe that the Zone is man-made. I've seen the Miracle Machine and the Brain Scorcher, but this... How did they manage to achieve that?

With something far more powerful. I believe that the Power Plant is somehow connected to this. Maybe one or more of the reactors used to work even after the incident in 1986. But that'd be only the possible power source. I heard rumours that there's a top secret installation even further north. An area so deep within the Zone that reality itself collapses in there. Vicious mutants, countless anomalies, Monolith troops... and a set of generators that were used in the failed experiment in 2006. They're mentioned in the documents you brought me. I might be able to find them one day.
Not the craziest things I've heard, believe me. I thank you for your information. All I ask is to remember I was never here.
Odd Request but I'll respect it. You have my word.
Good Luck.
Good. Take this as a token of gratitude and a reward for your assistance. We should go on our separate ways now, but I hope we'll meet again, someday. Farewell, who ever you are.
Ask Smith about what he knows about the Zone.
Smith might know more about the Zone.
Hey, Smith. I've been following the trail of a stalker named Strelok. He's headed north. Any ideas how can I get there?

Huh? Ah, right. Strelok. I recognise that name. Guy knows the Zone like the back of his hand. He's got quite a few achievements to his credit, too. Anyway, you wanna go north? You're finally ready to bid farewell to this cruel world?
Come on, I can manage just fine. Just tell me what'd be the best course of action.

The best? Don't go there. The second best? I suppose you should visit the eggheads in Yantar and get some device to shield you from the psy-field. Then, talk with Gatekeeper. The bastard eats Monolith fanatics for breakfast. He helps hold the Barrier and repeatedly fends off their southward incursions. Radar is the only semi-sensible route you'd want to take if you wish to go north. But be prepared for packs of vicious mutants, labyrinthine anomalies, extreme radiation levels, and well-armed Monolith soldiers guarding the way.
Doesn't sound great, but I don't intend to abandon my mission.
That's your choice, of course. Some adventurous stalkers do make it now and then. No pain, no gain... as the kids say. Anyway, Gatekeeper will know more about this, so he's your next stop.
Thanks, Smith. I'll be going now.
No problem. Good Luck rookie.
Return to Dusk to report your success
